# Chalk Studio

> An upscale, eclectic hair studio in Portland, Maine. Sister salon to Slate Studio. A collective of independent booth-rental stylists offering cuts, color, extensions, styling and barbering by appointment.

## About
- Owner: Harmony Bidwell, cosmetologist (also co-owner of Slate Studio and Apotheosis Salon).
- Model: booth rental. Every stylist is an independent business owner who sets their own hours, prices and schedule.
- Aesthetic: warm and eclectic, chalk-white walls with brass line-work, cognac leather, ochre velvet, walnut cabinetry, statement wallpapers and brass animal wall hooks. The refined, curious counterpoint to Slate's bright industrial space.
- Established: 2025, Portland, Maine.

## Services (vary by independent stylist)
- Cuts and shapes for all textures and genders
- Color: dimensional, live-in, balayage, grey blending, corrections, vivids
- Blondes and foiling
- Extensions
- Barbering: clipper work, beard trims, straight-razor shaves
- Special-occasion styling, blowouts and smoothing treatments
